description: Sign up or sign in to email59. Pass email to have a 6-digit code emailed, then call again with email and otp to get a session key (a new email is signed up with 200 free emails a day). Or pass api_key to swap an API key for a session key. Send the key as the HTTP header 'Authorization: Bearer <session_key>'.

api_key.description: An e59_live_ API key, instead of email.

name: auth
title: Sign in to email59
